notes_add.text: Complete different-reader second reading: the original and each native half were inspected once, followed by eight existing tight crops. No new crop was created. All source words, agreements and differences in C/H, cancellations, insertion attachment, diagram objects, arrow endpoints, indices, ring signs, primes, punctuation and pencil pagination were checked. No change to the accepted fragment is proposed.

The top insertion and its existing TikZ guide already preserve the visible word sequence and attachment. The thin guide crosses the f region of définit but does not cancel the verb. Both the opening canceled word and the diagram’s canceled via : tilde Pi label keep their distinct states.

The triangular diagram’s upper, upward and curved arrows have pointed heads; the two assignment arrows also have left mapsto bars. The relation next to the upward arrow consists of two vertical waves. The later displayed relation has a wave plus a lower bar. These distinct physical forms are preserved.

The NB literally opens with [ and closes with ). Its underline, action-ring sign, wording renversé les op. de pi, comma, and final short form à dr are retained. No normalization to matching brackets, digit zero, expanded droite, or trailing suspension points is made.

M0709 remains Gamma/F. Clear F graphs elsewhere have longer, higher middle bars, whereas the disputed actor’s spur is very short and low. This supports retaining the existing preferred alternative only provisionally. No independently contrary clear letter is replaced to obtain a coherent actor. The later gamma variable is not used to force the reading.

The object-condition operator cluster is retraced but remains readable as Ob Rev Pi. Its prime, membership sign and enclosing parentheses are preserved without inventing a deleted predecessor. All four primed Pi occurrences and both later gamma occurrences were checked separately.

The final line remains On trouve que cela signifie, with unaccented lowercase cela and no final stop. Both pencil page numbers, 13 and 25, remain attributed to an unnamed pencil hand. No continuation beyond this sheet is supplied.

The source’s functor construction, limit-preservation claim, compatibility isomorphisms and transitivity claim were read as background assertions. This audit performed visual comparison, not a proof or a new mathematical type check. The prior first-pass main-reader event is not duplicated as an event of this audit.
